caseName: W. F. Richardson, Jr., Co. v. Hines
caseNameFull: W. F. Richardson, Jr., Company, Inc. v. Walker D. Hines, Director General of Railroads, etc Mayo Milling Company, Inc. v. Walker D. Hines, Director General of Railroads, etc Adams Grain & Provision Company v. Walker D. Hines, Director General of Railroads, etc and Adams Grain & Provision Company v. John Barton Payne, Director General of Railroads, etc
attorneys: Mr. David H. Leake and Mr. Walter Leake, for defendants in error, in support of the motion. Mr. Robert H. Talley, for plaintiffs in error, in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of United States v. Krall, 174 U. S. 385, 389-391; German National Bank v. Speckert, 181 U. S. 405, 409; United States v. Beatty, 232 U. S. 463, 466; Arnold v. Guimarin & Co., 263 U. S. 427. And see decision this day announced in Dupont de Nemours & Co. v. Davis, ante, 456.
